name: Ryakudatsu Sareta Fiancee ~Koibito Masumi to Otouto no Himitsu
original_name: 略奪された婚約者 ～恋人・真澄と弟の秘密
source:
A few years after leaving his hometown, the protagonist Yuto reunites with his childhood friend Masumi and they start dating, and later get engaged. They are
now living together in their new home and are living happily.

One day, he receives a call from his younger brother Hayato, who he has been somewhat estranged from recently because he now lives in the countryside, saying that he has come to Tokyo. When he hears the situation, he learns that his company went bankrupt, so he stays in a business hotel and comes here to look for work. 

Wanting to help his younger brother, Yuto invites him to stay at his house for a while. Although his younger brother refuses, saying that it is wrong to stay at a place where his fiancee is living together, Masumi convinces him that he need not feel uncomfortable because he is also his childhood friend, and takes him to his house.

However, contrary to his expectations, Masumi seems confused about his younger brother staying over. However, after learning the situation, she accepts the proposal, and they start living together with their younger brother. Yuto remembers the times when the three of them used to play together in the past, and wants to continue to get along well with his younger brother.

However, what Hayato and Masumi were doing without Yuto's knowledge...
Soon, Yuto would find out in a shocking way.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1254668&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
离开故乡数年后，主人公悠人与青梅竹马真澄重逢并开始交往，随后顺利订下婚约。如今两人在新居里过着甜蜜幸福的同居生活。

某一天，悠人接到了弟弟隼打来的电话——由于隼一直留在老家生活，兄弟俩近来多少有些疏远，而隼在电话里表示自己已经来到了东京。问清原委后悠人才得知，弟弟就职的公司不幸破产，眼下正暂住在商务酒店里四处找工作。

一心想帮衬弟弟的悠人主动邀请他来家里暂住一阵子。弟弟起初连连推辞，觉得打扰哥哥与未婚妻同居的爱巢实在不妥；但在真澄“大家本来就是青梅竹马，不用见外”的热情劝说下，最终还是跟着哥哥住进了家中。

然而出乎悠人意料的是，真澄对弟弟留宿一事似乎显得有些心神不宁。不过了解实际处境后，她还是答应了这一安排，三人就此开始了同居生活。回想起儿时三人一起玩耍的旧时光，悠人满心期盼今后也能与弟弟和睦相处。

可背着毫不知情的悠人，隼与真澄暗地里究竟在做些什么……
不久后，悠人便将以令人震惊的方式亲眼撞破真相。

[译自[url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1254668&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
